title: SQL injection
flaw: Concatenated user input in research search SQL.
scenario: If search concatenates input, a crafted query can bypass record filtering and disclose nonpublic research metadata. Successful SQL injection depends on the actual query and database grants.
control: Parameterized search and publication filtering; synthetic exploit comparison and regression tests pass.
status: Implemented locally; residual assumptions require human review

title: Object authorization bypass
flaw: Record retrieval checks login but not permission on the requested record.
scenario: A user changes a record ID and reads another research team’s nonpublic record or service request. Client-hidden links do not enforce authorization.
control: Owner-or-staff predicates on records; default denial; cross-user tests pass. Collaborator grants are not implemented.
status: Implemented locally; service workflow persistence proposed

title: Public private-data export
flaw: Private exports or backup objects inherit public-read storage permissions.
scenario: An operator accidentally publishes a research export. Anyone with its URL can obtain nonpublic records; encryption at rest does not stop an authorized public read.
control: Local temporary backup only. Cloud public-access blocking and expiring download controls remain proposed.
status: Proposed cloud extension; no public export route

title: Committed credentials
stride: Spoofing; Information disclosure; Elevation of privilege
flaw: Live service credentials or signing secrets are committed to version control.
scenario: A repository reader obtains a secret and impersonates a service if network access and credential permissions permit. Removing the file alone does not revoke a leaked secret.
control: Pre-commit rejection, Gitleaks CI and protected branches; rotate any real leaked credential. Native private-repo push protection unavailable.
status: Implemented controls; owner-authorized merge exception is not peer review

title: Missing database isolation
agent: Authenticated peer exploiting another query flaw
flaw: Broad service role has no row policy or equivalent verified isolation.
scenario: A missed application permission check exposes rows across research groups. Missing RLS is a defense gap, not by itself proof that a user can query the database.
control: Non-owner runtime and tested application predicates; RLS not implemented.
status: Partial defense; missed future query checks remain a risk

title: Session interception
flaw: An HTTP/session path exposes credentials or cookies.
scenario: A victim uses an insecure session path and an observer obtains a usable session. Ordinary Wi-Fi visibility does not decrypt correctly validated HTTPS.
control: Hashed expiring bearer sessions and revocation; local HTTP only. Production HTTPS remains required. No cookie authentication.

title: Unsafe document processing
flaw: Optional attachment parser is vulnerable or execution is permitted in upload storage.
scenario: If uploads are enabled, a malicious file exploits a vulnerable parser or unsafe execution path, giving a runtime foothold. A PDF extension or polyglot alone does not execute code.
control: No upload or attachment parsing endpoint; defer until isolated parser security is reviewed.
status: Avoided in current scope; proposed feature risk

title: Database extortion
agent: Ransomware operator with credentials or DB exploit
stride: Denial of service; Tampering; Information disclosure
flaw: Public DB route plus exploitable authentication or overprivileged credentials.
scenario: An attacker reaches the DB, gains sufficient privileges, and corrupts or extracts research records. Permanent loss also requires unavailable or compromised recovery copies.
control: Loopback database binding, separate roles and actual synthetic restore test; immutable offsite recovery remains proposed.
status: Local controls verified; production recovery pending

title: Resource exhaustion
flaw: Search cost, request rate or body size is unbounded.
scenario: Authenticated staff floods costly graph-solving scenarios or clients flood search. Unbounded child processes would exhaust host resources.
control: Rate/body limits; staff-only solver; 5000 steps, 25000 edges, 50000 memberships, 2 MiB body; two Python workers, five-second timeout, 8 MiB output ceiling. No OS memory sandbox.
status: Local controls tested; distributed/OS resource isolation pending

title: Stored browser script
flaw: Untrusted research text reaches an unsafe HTML rendering sink.
scenario: Stored content executes when another user views a record. It may perform same-origin actions; HttpOnly cookies cannot be read directly by script.
control: JSON-only API with no HTML rendering frontend; safe output rendering required for future UI.
status: Future frontend sink must be reviewed

title: Unattributable record changes
flaw: Research updates lack an attributable append-only audit record.
scenario: An editor changes a research stage then denies doing it; writable or missing logs prevent reliable reconstruction.
control: Server-derived audit actors and runtime INSERT/SELECT-only grants; administrator can still alter history.
status: Local grant controls verified; immutable external logging proposed
